name: S-Energy Co.,Ltd.
summary: S-Energy Co., Ltd. specializes in solar energy solutions, providing photovoltaic (PV) power systems and sun-tracking technologies. Their product offerings include both conventional PV modules and building-integrated photovoltaic (BIPV) modules. The company was established by Sung-Min Hong on January 12, 2001, and its primary operations are based in Seongnam-si, South Korea.
